front.intro: Behind this East End bungalow, a covered garage and a long covered patio sit in a fully fenced yard, with a new driveway running down the side to reach them. Inside, wood-look floors run from the front door to the Kitchen, where navy cabinets and stone-look counters surround a stainless range. Cullinan Park is under a mile away.

back.title: The Yard, the Plan and the Neighborhood
back.planNote: The Primary Bedroom sits at the back of the house, with its bath beside it. Approximate and not to scale; the buyer verifies room sizes.
back.roomIntro: Every room is on one floor, with the living areas up front and the bedrooms along the hall behind them. The Primary sits at the back of the house. The covered patio and garage sit out in the yard. Sizes are approximate and come from the listing.

photo0.name: Rear of the House
photo0.text: From the back of the lot, the rear of the home shows the same new Hardi Plank siding as the front. The covered patio runs along the side of the house, next to the garage.

photo1.name: Covered Garage
photo1.text: Heavy wood posts and a solid roof cover a plank-walled space with a concrete floor. An 8'11" x 25'11" patio sits alongside it, in the fully fenced backyard behind the house.

claim.text: The lot has never flooded, and a wide concrete walk leads from the street to the covered porch. A new driveway runs down the side to the covered garage out back. The yard is fully fenced. New flooring and lighting carry through every room. Greenway Coffee on Telephone Road is under half a mile away.
claim.head: What is new

back.footnote: Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Room sizes are approximate. Living area per HCAD.

top.title: Living Opens to Dining and the Kitchen

lead.name: Living Room
lead.text: A wide cased opening joins the Living Room to the Dining area and the Kitchen, so one room reads straight through to the next. A tall double-pane window faces the front yard, and a long clerestory window set high on the wall adds daylight and keeps the street out of view. Wood-look flooring runs through from the front door with no threshold.

side.name: Kitchen
side.text: An L with a peninsula, navy lower cabinets and white shaker uppers. A stainless range sits under a chimney hood, with a full-height stone-look backsplash behind it. The pantry is close by. All of it is new. Two pendant lights hang over the breakfast bar.

side.name: Breakfast Nook
side.text: A large double-pane window brightens the nook. A door gives direct access to the backyard. It opens to a small deck, with steps down to the fenced yard. The Kitchen sits right beside it, with the Dining area a few steps beyond.

row.name: Craftsman Door
row.text: The Craftsman-style front door has a divided-light window and opens from the covered porch straight into the Living Room. Wood-look flooring starts at the threshold.

row.name: Dining Area
row.text: One open run reaches from the Dining area to the front door, with the Living Room on one side and the Kitchen on the other. A sputnik-style light hangs over the table.

row.name: Breakfast Bar
row.text: Two pendant lights hang over a stone-look counter with room for barstools. The Dining area sits right beside the bar. The peninsula keeps the cook part of the room.

bottom.title: A Vaulted Primary at the Back of the Home

lead.name: Primary Bedroom
lead.text: The only vaulted ceiling in the house sits over the Primary, with an exposed painted beam running its length. Windows on two walls bring in daylight, and a double-door closet opens beside the doorway to the bath. The room sits at the back of the home, well away from the street. A short hall leads back toward the Dining area and the Living Room.

side.name: Primary Bath
side.text: Double sinks sit in a marble-look top with a matching backsplash, on a dark navy vanity with drawers. The shower is tiled floor to ceiling in marble-look tile, with a sliding glass door, a rain showerhead and a handheld on a slide. All of it is new.

side.name: Hall Bath
side.text: A tub with a full-height marble-look tile surround, marble-look tile floors and a window. Bedrooms 2 and 3 share this bath. Deep built-in linen shelves sit just outside the door, with room for towels. Everything in it is new.

row.name: Primary Closet
row.text: Double doors open to a shelving tower down the center, with hanging rods on both sides. Shelves above hold bins and luggage. A doorway nearby leads to the Primary Bath.

row.name: Bedroom 2
row.text: The larger secondary bedroom sits at the front corner, with windows on two walls facing the neighborhood. Daylight reaches the room from two sides, across the front yard.

row.name: Bedroom 3
row.text: A large window brings in daylight, and the reach-in closet sits beside the door. That leaves the window wall free for a desk. The room sits between Bedroom 2 and the Primary.

a.text: Come see the East End bungalow with a covered garage and a covered patio side by side behind it. A wide cased opening joins the Living Room, the Dining area and the Kitchen. The Primary sits at the back, under a vaulted ceiling. Light fills the front rooms.

jl.front9: Board and batten fills the front gable, and a stained wood door sits under the covered stoop at the top of three blue-gray steps. Inside, a wide cased opening joins the Living Room, the Dining area and the L-shaped Kitchen over wood-look floors. Out back, a covered garage and a covered patio share the fenced yard. The house is in the East End, minutes from Downtown and EaDo.

jl.about9: The nook sits beside the Kitchen with windows on two walls, and two pendants hang over the peninsula, with room for barstools. The hall bath has a tub with marble-look tile to the ceiling and a pebble tile niche. Bedroom 2 takes the front corner, and Bedroom 3 keeps its closet on the hall side, which leaves the window wall open for a desk. Hardi Plank siding and a new roof cover the outside, and the driveway out front is new.
jl.about11: The nook sits beside the Kitchen with windows on two walls, and two pendants hang over the peninsula, with room for barstools. The hall bath has a tub with marble-look tile to the ceiling and a pebble tile niche, and open linen shelves stand just outside it. Bedroom 2 takes the front corner, and Bedroom 3 keeps its closet on the hall side, which leaves the window wall open for a desk. Hardi Plank siding and a new roof cover the outside, the driveway is new, the yard is fenced all the way around, and wide white steps lead from the deck down to the grass. Beside the nook, a rear door leads out to the deck. Greenway Coffee and Cullinan Park are a short walk away.

js.front9: The sellers had full-size photos of every room, a floor plan and a printed brochure ready for the first showing. I read every offer with them line by line, kept the inspection and the appraisal on schedule, and called each week. I was at the table on closing day, and I stayed until the keys changed hands.
